svg.title: White Relief
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry, interpretive colours. White curved raised form over a white rectangular support. Neutral edge guide distinguishes the relief, not grey paint. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sfmoma.org/artwork/99.358/; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
